title: Associate General Counsel for Faculty Affairs and Employment or a Senior Associate General Coun...
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

We are recruiting an Associate General Counsel for Faculty Affairs and Employment or a Senior Associate General Counsel, Faculty Affairs, Employment & Labor Relations. The selected incumbent provides in‑house legal counsel and strategic collaboration with Howard University and Howard University Hospital executives, academic administrators and the Office of Human Resources professionals regarding a comprehensive range of employment and labor relations matters. Advises and represents the University and Hospital on employment matters including but not limited to wrongful termination, discrimination, workers’ compensation and wage and hour claims brought by University and Hospital employees, including providing advice and counseling to University executives, academic administrators and Office of Human Resources professionals to ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulations as well as advising on such matters in litigation.

Provides counsel and legal sufficiency review of legal documents, settlement agreements, discipline, suspensions, terminations, workplace policies, handbooks and other documents concerning employees. Supervises and manages outside counsel in employment and labor relations matters.

A candidate for the Senior Associate General Counsel will have substantial labor experience, in addition to a strong foundation in an employment‑related practice. The Senior Associate General Counsel will provide in‑house legal counsel services and represents Howard University as the supervisor of the primary in‑house labor attorney handling all matters involving the bargaining units of the University and Hospital and related collective bargaining agreements.

Supervisory Accountability

A candidate for the Associate General Counsel position will not have any direct supervisory accountability, but is expected to be primarily responsible for all employment and faculty related matters with a high level of autonomy. The Senior Associate General Counsel will supervise all employment‑related and labor‑related work of other staff attorneys. Serves as supervisor of other in‑house counsel who will be first chair on labor, collective bargaining and union matters.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, and staff of the University. External contacts include federal and local courts and administrative agencies including EEOC, OHR, DOL and OWH.

Principal Accountabilities

A candidate for the Associate General Counsel position will have primary responsibilities to provide in‑house legal advice, interpretation, and representation in a broad range of legal issues with employment related matters with knowledge of the labor process. In addition, a candidate for the Senior Associate General Counsel position will have supervisory responsibility for labor matters, including but not limited to representation in government agency investigations, grievances, arbitrations, and in cases before the National Labor Relations Board.

Responsibilities include reviewing and drafting workplace handbooks, policies and guidelines for legal sufficiency; providing review and recommendations regarding various regulatory and compliance matters. Other responsibilities include conducting formal training on EEO, wage & hour, mandated leave benefits, union representation, whistleblower, and other pertinent employment and labor law topics for new hires, current employees, and leadership. The incumbent also prepares legal documents such as offer letters, academic appointment contracts, settlement agreements, termination agreements, collective‑bargaining agreements, employment agreements. Also responsible for overseeing preparation of responses to information requests directed at Howard University or Hospital, advisory memoranda and documents relating to collective bargaining agreements, litigation matters or agency proceedings.

Represents the University in legal and quasi‑legal proceedings, including the District of Columbia and Federal courts and before government agencies on employment and labor relations matters and on other legal matters. Represents the University in hearings, meetings and in other forums related to University legal matters, as needed. Drafts and negotiates commitments involving University resources; principally contracts, settlements, other agreements and statements of University policy for subsequent approval by the General Counsel and University Officers. Reviews documents for other University offices for legal implications and possible legal policy questions. Responds to University officials’ request for advice in areas of assigned responsibility. Serves as office resource on updates and developments in employment and labor law.

Provides legal expertise and otherwise represents the office in meetings with University officials and individuals outside of the University. Provides counseling, advice, and guidance to academic administrators, supervisors and other management officials on faculty and staff conduct and performance problems. Provides assistance with conflict resolution, as requested. Furnishes recommendations to academic administrators, department heads, managers, and supervisors concerning possible courses of action in handling employee problems and concerns. Reviews employee discipline and discharge matters and makes recommendation for appropriate course of action. Reviews statistics and surveys and prepares analyses for review by the General Counsel. Reviews periodic utilization reports and develops appropriate management responses. Performs other job‑related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

Detailed knowledge of federal and local laws applicable to employment and labor relations, and judicial and administrative agency systems and procedures. Ability to conduct and manage adversarial proceedings on behalf of the University and Hospital before courts and administrative agencies. Ability to plan, direct and conduct independent legal research and related analyses on a variety of labor and employment law topics. Ability to participate effectively in fact‑finding investigations, present findings and develop related recommendations. Ability to articulate the University’s position, listen and negotiate effectively. Superior verbal and written communication skills. Ability to draft, review, revise and edit documents in Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Ability to identify possible need for action and to plan, supervise, and execute appropriate assignments with minimal guidance or supervision. Ability to work productively under pressure, to adhere to and enforce deadlines, and to project need for and effectuate team efforts required to meet deadlines. Ability to follow guidance and direction and to provide effective guidance and direction. Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students, University officials, union representatives and the general public.

Minimum Requirements

A candidate for the Associate General Counsel position will have a Juris Doctor from an accredited law school and six years of post J.D. legal experience which includes at least four years of substantial employment experience, with additional knowledge of the labor process. A candidate for the Senior Associate General Counsel will have a Juris Doctor from an accredited law school and eight years of substantial labor and employment experience. All candidates must have a strong academic record; excellent oral and written communication skills. Membership or eligibility for membership in the District of Columbia Bar is required.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Salary Range

The anticipated salary for the Associate General Counsel position is $172,800.

The anticipated salary for the Senior Associate General Counsel position is $207,800.

O Que Você Vai Encontrar

We are seeking a Director, Scientific & Regulatory Affairs (SRA) Brazil to provide scientific and regulatory leadership across one of our most strategically important markets. What You’ll Do For Us

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Proven expertise in regulatory advocacy, claims substantiation, labeling, marketing communications review, and product compliance across the product life cycle.
  • Ability to influence cross‑functional and external stakeholders in a matrixed organization without direct people management responsibility.
  • Strong judgment, analytical thinking, and comfort operating in complex, evolving regulatory environments.
  • Experience working in emerging markets and within global organizations strongly preferred.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English; Spanish proficiency is a plus.

What We'll Do For You

  • Global Exposure: Collaborate with regional and global SRA leaders, contributing Brazilian perspectives to enterprise‑level scientific and regulatory strategies.

  • Purpose‑Driven Work: Play a meaningful role in advancing science‑based policy and enabling sustainable, responsible business growth.

Skills

Regulatory Environment; Leadership; Strategic Influence; Regulatory Advocacy; Regulatory Issues; organization; Analytical Thinking; Active Listening; Food Sciences; Food Technology; Risk Management; Communication; Government Affairs; Regulatory Policies; Taking Initiative; Cross-Functional Teamwork

We are seeking experienced marine seismic processing and depth imaging specialists (with 5 plus years of industry experience) to join our growing and energetic project teams in delivering high-quality seismic services to the oil and gas industry. The successful candidate must be highly motivated to work in a fast‑moving and high‑tech work environment, have the capacity to work independently with careful attention to detail, and demonstrate initiative and problem‑solving skills. He or she should have several years of practical experience in seismic processing ideally with depth imaging knowledge too.   • BSc, MSc or Ph.D. in Geophysics / Physics / Maths / Electrical Engineering, or equivalent.
  • Minimum 5 years of practical work experience in a marine seismic processing/depth imaging team.
  • Experience of OBC or OBN would be beneficial.
  • Knowledge of, and experience working with, Linux and/or Unix, and industry processing/depth imaging tools; basic scripting and/or programming skills.
  • Excellent communication skills; fluent in English.
  • Organised and able to produce accurate work.

Diferencial

Além disso, poderá fazer parte de um Clube de Benefícios bem diferenciado.

  • E os papais também terão esse privilégio de acompanhar bem de perto seu bebê nos primeiros dias de vida com a licença estendida no Benefício Paternidade , de até 20 dias

Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, aWLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento deconcessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operaçõesEquipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR).

No segmento doagronegócio , por meio de suas controladasFartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% daCHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

  • Padronizar o processo de desmontagem na unidade de Lavras em conjunto com a empresa terceira.

  • Garantir alinhamento técnico com as áreas envolvidas.

  • Residência obrigatória na cidade de Lavras.

  • Refeição no local - para garantir refeições mais práticas e tranquilas no seu dia a dia.
  • Vale Transporte - para apoiar seu deslocamento no trajeto casa x trabalho x casa.

A atitude adotada é que nenhuma ideia é uma má ideia e as melhores ideias são aquelas que devem ser testadas e experimentadas. Você precisará prosperar e entregar resultados em um ambiente ambíguo, rápido e dinâmico. A função envolve:

Responsabilidades

  • Estar presencialmente na estação de entrega. Amazon lidera operações 24-7, e portanto, trabalhar em diferentes turnos será parte dessa função, incluindo finais de semana e feriados.
  • Criar e cultivar um ambiente de trabalho seguro, identificando oportunidades de segurança em sua área de trabalho.
  • Liderar e treinar os associados para entregar o melhor serviço aos nossos clientes.
  • Garantir que os pedidos dos clientes sejam atendidos de acordo com as diretrizes de segurança e qualidade.

  • Monitoramento do andamento das rotas, atuando de forma proativa para identificar e corrigir desvios e adequar, com foco na superação da expectativa do cliente e no gerenciamento dos custos de operação.
  • Condução de reuniões, atribuição de funções e - Trabalhar com KPIs como despacho pontual, sucesso na entrega no primeiro dia (On Time Dispatch, First Day Delivery Success) e aprimoramento do atendimento ao cliente.
  • Ficar obcecado por métricas e mergulhar fundo para encontrar as causas raízes rapidamente para impulsionar as melhorias.
  • Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos sem sacrificar a qualidade ou a funcionalidade principal.
  • Fornecer suporte diário durante o lançamento / implementação de sistemas / processos mais novos e coletar feedback.
  • Utilizar continuamente ferramentas de software e hardware para garantir as operações normais do dia a dia. Garantir que os associados tenham ferramentas adequadas para realizar o trabalho e coordenar o reparo ou substituição quando necessário.
  • Comunicar as métricas diárias e relatar exceções a outros departamentos em Operações e em toda a Amazon, conforme necessário.

A entidade atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, alinhada às políticas de saúde e educação, e como organização social habilitada em vários estados gerenciando serviços de saúde.

Com foco na prevenção, tratamento e promoção da saúde em todas as fases, a SPDM amplia suas áreas de atuação, incluindo Assistência Social e Educação, consolidando-se como instituição filantrópica de grande porte.

Promover a facilitação da comunicação não verbal, ensinando a usar o corpo e gesto como formas de expressão, especialmente para pacientes com barreiras na linguagem oral.

Realizar orientações domiciliares, prescrindo atividades simples que estimulem autonomia e organização motora em casa.

SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em unidades hospitalares com plano de carreira, prioritariamente para pessoas com deficiência.

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, com qualidade técnica, compromisso social e ambiental.

Ser referência em gestão de serviços de saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento de qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

title: Material Controller
description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us:

SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with Advancing our Core: continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably. Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Purpose

  • As Material Controller, your core responsibility is to manage and maintain the flow of materials required for projects and for the operations. Your role is crucial in ensuring the efficient and effective management of materials and inventory to support uninterrupted project and operations’ execution. This role requires a strong understanding of supply chain management, inventory control, and coordination with multiple departments to support project timelines and operational excellence.

Responsibilities

  • Inventory Management: You maintain and lead accurate counting and records of material in stock. You oversee material handling, storage, and preservation to prevent damage, loss, or deterioration of materials. You ensure that the storage areas are kept clean and organized.
  • Material Movement: You keep records of the in and out stock movements. You initiate, treat and coordinate the demand of transfer and move of material between storage locations. You handle the distribution of materials, supplies, and equipment based on incoming requests and orders.
  • Coordination: You maintain good communication with the yard, the warehouse or cargo teams with regards to equipment that requires additional coordination from them.
  • Documentation: You maintain and lead the maintenance of comprehensive material records, including receipts, issuances, and transfers, and generate/oversee reports for management and audit purposes.
  • Compliance: You ensure adherence to relevant safety, environmental, and industry regulations in all material-related activities.
  • Material Planning: You track material consumption, and you collaborate with Projects, Maintenance and Supply Chain teams to support the material requirement forecast and to develop effective material planning strategies. You support the identification of potential material shortages, bottlenecks, and supply chain risks. You support the implementation of proactive measures to mitigate risks and develop contingency plans to address unexpected challenges.
  • Material Replenishment: If you are involved in the material replenishment process, you initiate the demand and the replenishment tasks. You coordinate replenishment or material transfer processes to avoid shortages and surplus.
  • Inspection and material Quality Control: If you are involved in the material reception process, you verify and lead the verification of the quality and specifications of incoming materials. You conduct and lead inspections and address any discrepancies or non‑compliance issues.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Stock Management, Supply chain, or Logistics Management.

Experience

  • Proven track record in material control or inventory management within the oil and gas industry or a similar sector.
  • Good knowledge of materials used in oil and gas operations, including equipment and spare parts, and industry specific regulations.
  • Understanding of the procurement processes.
  • Strong experience in warehouse management systems and inventory tracking tool. Knowledge of ERP systems and data analysis tools being preferable.
  • Analytical and problem‑solving skills to optimize material usage and reduce waste.
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail to maintain accurate records and comply with industry standards.
  • Good communication and teamwork abilities to collaborate.

SBM Offshore does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non‑disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

Decentralized Masters is at the forefront of DeFi education globally. In just three years, we have grown from a pioneering pair of co‑founders to over 120 dedicated professionals. Our commitment is to deliver unparalleled resources designed for long‑term success in the world of DeFi and Web3, ensuring our members not only safeguard but also enhance their financial future.

Our Vision

Our goal is to create the largest and most influential DeFi ecosystem the world has ever seen, starting with becoming the gold standard in DeFi education. This vision is ambitious, transformative, and poised to change the landscape of digital finance.

Are You Ready?

This is more than just a job; it's an opportunity to shape the future of Web3 technology and education. Are you ready to be part of our vision to redefine what's possible in DeFi and beyond? Apply below, and let's explore this journey together.

Check us out here: Decentralized Masters

What will you be doing?

The Sales Operations Specialist is responsible for ensuring the sales organization operates with speed, accuracy, visibility, and accountability. This role owns the day‑to‑day execution and optimization of the sales tech stack—primarily "HubSpot"—so that Membership Directors (MDs), Setters, and Sales Leadership can focus on selling, not admin. This is a hands‑on, systems‑focused role, not a people manager. You will work closely with Sales Leadership, Marketing, Fulfillment, and Data to maintain clean pipelines, automate workflows, enforce process discipline, and deliver reliable reporting. At Decentralized Masters, Sales Ops is mission‑critical. This role directly impacts close rates, cash collection, forecasting accuracy, and the overall scalability of the revenue engine.

Key Responsibilities

CRM Ownership & Sales Systems

  • Own accuracy of HubSpot CRM configuration: pipelines, deal stages, properties, workflows, and permissions
  • Ensure every lead, deal, and contact has correct lead status, lifecycle stages, ownership, and next steps
  • Maintain strict data hygiene standards (identifying/merging duplicates, no stale deals, missing properties, or broken workflows)
  • Enforce CRM usage standards across Setters and MDs

Sales Automation & Workflow Management

  • Build and maintain automation for:
    • Lead routing and assignment
    • Task creation and follow‑ups
    • Deal stage progression
    • Call outcomes and disposition tracking
  • Reduce manual admin work for sales reps wherever possible
  • QA all automations to ensure reliability and compliance

Pipeline, Forecasting & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate, real‑time visibility into:
    • Pipeline value and velocity
    • Close rates and conversion metrics
    • DPL (Deals Per Lead), APS, and other core KPIs
  • Build and maintain sales dashboards for leadership
  • Support forecasting and revenue reporting in collaboration with Finance and Data teams

Sales Tools & Integration

  • Manage and support integrations between HubSpot and:
    • Dialers (e.g., "Aloware")
    • Calendars and scheduling tools
    • Payment platforms (e.g., "Whop")
    • Analytics and BI tools
  • Troubleshoot system issues and coordinate fixes with internal tech or third‑party vendors

Process Enforcement & Enablement

  • Translate sales process changes into CRM logic and automation
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to ensure systems reinforce desired behaviors
  • Create and maintain SOPs for sales roles, systems and workflows
  • Act as the point person for Sales Ops requests, improvements, and bug fixes
  • Support and respond to Sales Ops requests submitted via Slack channels

Compliance & Data Integrity

  • Ensure CRM processes align with internal compliance standards (FTC/SEC‑aware language, DISCLAIMERS, documentation)
  • Maintain audit‑ready records for sales activity and deal history
  • Partner with Security/IT on access control and data governance

Requirements

What do you bring?

Required Experience

  • 2-5+ years in Sales Operations, RevOps, or CRM Administration
  • Hands‑on experience with "HubSpot" or similar CRM (required)
  • Mid‑Senior level Sales Operations experience
  • Strong background in sales automation and workflow design
  • Experience supporting high‑ticket or complex sales cycles preferred

Skills & Attributes

  • Highly systems‑oriented and detail‑driven
  • Strong understanding of sales metrics and funnels
  • Comfortable working cross‑functionally with Sales, Marketing, Fulfillment, and Data
  • Proactive problem‑solver who spots issues before they become revenue problems
  • Clear communicator who can translate business needs into system logic

Bonus (Nice to Have)

  • Experience in high‑growth, remote‑first environments
  • Familiarity with "Whop", "Aloware", or BI tools
  • Exposure to compliance‑heavy industries (finance, education, crypto, etc.)

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Remote‑first culture with a globally distributed team
  • Opportunity to own the organic growth engine of a fast‑scaling DeFi brand
  • Access to cutting‑edge tools, data, and creative freedom to innovate
  • A values‑driven company culture that rewards results, autonomy, and excellence

If you are ready to take on a challenge that will shape the future of crypto finance and grow with a team of innovators, we want to hear from you!

title: Montevideo Development Graduate Programme
description:
Based in Montevideo, the two-year Development Graduate Programme offers, 3 × 8 month rotations, across Deals Desk, Operations and Trade Finance in Energy or Metals and Minerals.

Throughout the programme, graduates gain practical experience and exposure to the full trade lifecycle, working at the core of our operations. By building expertise across these critical functions, graduates develop a strong foundation for success in high-impact middle office roles in Deals Desk, Operations and Trade Finance and are well‑positioned to grow into future leadership positions.

Guided by some of the most experienced professionals in the industry, graduates receive ongoing support and development opportunities, providing them with the skills, mindset and confidence to help shape the next chapter of our business.

Deals Desk

Deals Desk is responsible for accurate mark‑to‑market valuation, daily P&L and risk and exposure reporting. Deals Desk is an independent control function that works closely with commercial, middle and back‑office teams to ensure timely trade capture and effective management of trading positions in our trading and risk management systems.

Responsibilities include
  • Reviewing and verifying trades and trade terms
  • Producing daily P&L and exposure reports
  • Liaising with traders, operations and finance to reconcile positions
  • Investigating and resolving trade discrepancies

Operations

Operations coordinates the physical movement and delivery of commodities, ensuring contracts are executed efficiently and profitably.

Responsibilities include
  • Managing vessel or land logistics and documentation
  • Liaising with counter parties and terminal
  • Tracking cargo movements and inventories
  • Ensuring compliance with contractual and regulatory requirements

Trade Finance

Trade Finance designs and implements the financing solutions that enable the physical movement of commodities, while managing credit and performance risks.

Responsibilities include
  • Structuring and executing real‑world commodity trade finance deals
  • Drafting, negotiating and managing trade documents such as letters of credit, guarantees and receivables financing
  • Monitoring global trade flows, payment schedules and risk exposure across complex transactions
  • Collaborating with traders, operations, credit teams and banking partners to resolve day‑to‑day financing and logistics challenges

Knowledge Skills And Abilities

  • 0-2 years of postgraduate working experience
  • Fluency in English and Spanish - both oral and written
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • High degree of intellectual curiosity, passion, motivation and grit
  • Ability to remove roadblocks and break down barriers to get the job done
  • Passion for working in a collaborative, challenging and dynamic environment
  • A global, innovative mindset

Applications will close on 31st May 2026.

description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Safety Advisor to join the Saudi Aramco Loss Prevention organization (LP).

LP is responsible for providing both day-to-day in-field occupational and process safety support to Saudi Aramco operations, as well as centralized technical support and consulting function. Our field offices are located in Abqaiq, Riyadh, Ras Tanura, Dhahran, Udhailiyah, Jeddah (including Yanbu and Jazan), and Tanajib. Through these offices, LP provides its services to all Saudi Aramco facilities and departments that are located throughout the Kingdom.

Your primary role is to provide daily support to company facilities and departments, helping them effectively implement the Saudi Aramco Safety Management System expectations and associated programs, as well as assuring compliance to all company safety requirements.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Facilitate implementation of the Saudi Aramco Safety Management System, as well as its objectives and expectations, including developing associated safety processes, and participating in self-assessments.
  • Conduct field inspections/reviews to assess compliance to company and international codes and standards, identify safety concerns, formulate solutions, and develop practical and cost-effective corrective actions.
  • Identify, evaluate, recommend actions, and follow up on critical, yet universal safety tasks and control methodologies related to operational safety practices (e.g., work at height, isolation/LOTO, permit to work, hydrogen sulfide, confined space entry, excavations).
  • Participate in safety studies/activities using risk assessment and mitigation methodologies, such as: PHAs, HAZOPs, JSAs, incident investigations, compliance reviews, or insurance surveys.
  • Respond to emergency situations and incidents, either during or after regular working hours, to provide technical assistance and advice.
  • Participate in worksite contractor safety management activities (e.g., contractor selection and prequalification, monitoring of work site compliance, and measurement of performance).
  • Support the reporting, classification and investigation all incidents, and participating in incident investigations, determination of root causes, and proper recommendations to prevent recurrence.
  • Deliver Loss Prevention-specific training to employees, contractors, and outside parties.
  • Mentor other LP personnel.
  • You will hold a Bachelor of Science degree from an Accredited Institution and seven years of experience areas in the oil and gas, petrochemicals, or related industries, such as: operations and maintenance, plant engineering, construction, turnaround and inspection, safety program development, process safety, and audits/assessments.
  • Or you will have 15 years of relevant industry experience in the oil and gas, petrochemicals, or related industries, including a strong track record in delivering results, as referenced above, without a degree.
  • You will also have an excellent ability to communicate in English with peers as well as members of management, and be able to produce clear and concise oral and written reports in English.

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Auxiliar no desenvolvimento da vocalização e fala e na organização do discurso.
  • Promover atividades musicais em grupo para estimular o contato visual, o compartilhamento e a interação com pares.
  • Apoiar na regulação sensorial (especialmente auditiva) e na coordenação motora através do manuseio de instrumentos musicais.
  • Facilitar o desenvolvimento da expressão emocional promovendo a emersão das emoções e sensações e ajudando na identificação e expressão de sentimentos, melhorando o humor e o bem-estar.
  • Estimular a atenção, a concentração e a memória.
  • Fornecer suporte psicossocial aos usuários e as famílias.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Musicoterapia ou na área da saúde;
  • Especialização em Psicomotricidade;

Hope to hear from you soon!

We perform background checks on all final candidates.

Tieto declines calls from recruitment agencies.

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Informações adicionais

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

description:
Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support

  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

Reporting to the Sr. Director of IT for Auxiliary Enterprises, the IT Support Specialist is responsible for providing general IT support across all Auxiliary Enterprises. IT-related tasks may include setting up, managing, and troubleshooting technology systems used by each business unit associated with the Office of Auxiliary Enterprises. Duties may include providing end-user support with laptop and desktop computers; providing support for card readers, printers or other IT and computer peripherals; assistance with Howard University physical and Wi-Fi network; diagnosing and resolving hardware problems including specialized hardware such as point-of-sale terminals, building controllers, laundry machine interface devices, OR parking ticket issuing hand-held terminals; configuring and updating system and application software; and tracking down data and communication issues.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include faculty, staff, and students. External contacts include vendors, contractors, and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Provides technical support for various hardware used across Auxiliary Enterprises including point-of-sale terminals, printers, laptops, desktop computers, cameras, card readers, scanners, contactless readers, monitors, kitchen-display systems, time clocks, building/laundry controllers, building/laundry readers, point-of-sale terminals, peripherals, and other equipment used by contractors and employees in Auxiliary Enterprises.
  • Provide Tier-1 support for Dining Service point-of-sale terminals and peripherals.
  • Level Review diagnostics and assess the functionality and efficiency of systems.
  • Work with system providers in the support of various applications.
  • Work with Howard University ETS to implement, enforce and support security measures.
  • Monitor security certificates and company compliance with requirements.
  • Monitor systems to ensure they are operating as expected.
  • Provide technical support to Auxiliary Enterprises contract staff and troubleshoot computer systems and peripheral equipment used by Auxiliary Enterprises contractors.
  • Install and update company software and hardware as needed.
  • Anticipate and make recommendations regarding the replacement or updating of computer items.
  • Assist with installation, upgrades, and the disposal of IT-related products.
  • Coordinate with ETS and off-prem/cloud-based vendors to ensure that Auxiliary Enterprises systems and data are backed up and backups are verified and able to be restored when necessary.
  • Assemble, install, and configure systems and components per vendor specifications BUT within the policies, procedures, and best practices of Howard University, HU Enterprise Technology Services, and Auxiliary Enterprises.
  • Stay updated regarding the knowledge and skills needed to keep up with rapid advancements in computer technology.
  • Maintains logs of activities and completed work and provides reports to the Sr. Director. Specifically, Laundry System Status and the Auxiliary Enterprises IT Asset List. Additional logs may be assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Knowledge of TCP/IP, networking, and related technologies.
  • Advanced knowledge of the Microsoft Windows Operating system.

Informações adicionais

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesse nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.
  • Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

title: Lead Payroll Analyst
description:
Overview

Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us! The benefits information above is provided for guidance.

Job Purpose

Job Purpose

The Lead Payroll Analyst plays a key role in ensuring the accuracy, compliance, and effective operation of Howard University’s payroll processes. This position supports the review and validation of payroll data, monitors payroll activity for consistency, and assists in the timely processing of bi-weekly and off-cycle compensation for faculty, staff, and student workers. The Lead Payroll Analyst also serves as a primary resource for employee payroll inquiries, offering guidance and facilitating timely resolution with a strong customer service focus. The role helps maintain internal controls and supports cross-departmental collaboration to ensure payroll is administered in alignment with University policies, collective bargaining agreements, and applicable federal and state regulations.

Supervisory Authority

Supervisory Authority

None.

Nature And Scope

Nature And Scope

The Lead Payroll Analyst functions as an experienced payroll professional within the University’s centralized payroll structure and supports the accurate and timely execution of bi-weekly payrolls and supplemental off-cycle payments. The role requires close coordination with Human Resources, Budget, Benefits, Accounting, and departmental administrators to verify payroll data, ensure proper documentation, and support consistent payroll operations across the institution. This position interacts frequently with employees, supervisors, and campus partners to address payroll questions and provide guidance on payroll-related matters. The Lead Payroll Analyst must apply strong analytical skills, confidentiality, and sound judgment when evaluating payroll information or resolving issues. The role contributes to audit preparedness, supports payroll reconciliations, and assists with recurring quarterly and annual payroll reporting activities.

Principal Accountabilities

Principal Accountabilities

Payroll Preparation & Support

  • Prepare and validate payroll inputs in advance of each payroll cycle, ensuring HR-provided files (salaries, benefits, job changes) are complete and properly formatted for processing.
  • Perform pre-payroll audits to identify missing data, unexpected variances, incorrect deductions, or tax issues, and escalate findings to the Payroll Manager.
  • Support the Director/Manager during monthly payroll processing by running calculations, reviewing results, and resolving flagged errors.
  • Process routine off-cycle items such as corrections, small retro payments, and adjustments as directed by the Payroll Manager.

Employee Support & Inquiry Management

  • Manage the Payroll Inbox by monitoring, prioritizing, and responding to employee payroll questions related to pay, taxes, deductions, direct deposit, and time reporting.
  • Research and resolve routine issues; escalate complex or policy-impacting matters to the Payroll Manager.
  • Track common inquiry themes and recommend updates to FAQs or procedure guides.

Garnishments, Deductions & Payments

  • Process wage garnishments, tax levies, child support orders, and other wage attachments; maintain records and prepare remittance packets for manager approval.
  • Administer union dues, voluntary deductions, and retirement contributions that originate within Payroll’s purview (not HR-managed benefits).
  • Maintain logs of all remittances and assist in preparing reconciliations for manager review.

System Support (Workday & ADP)

  • Update and maintain basic Workday Payroll configuration items (simple deductions, tax updates, pay schedule updates) under guidance from the Payroll Manager.
  • Execute routine tests during Workday releases and patches; document issues and assist with troubleshooting.
  • Assist with ADP Tax Services interactions, including reviewing tax files, setting up new jurisdictions, and documenting tax notices for management action.

Reconciliation, Reporting & Compliance Support

  • Prepare standard payroll reports (registers, deduction reports, tax summaries) for manager review before final processing.
  • Assist with monthly reconciliations of payroll liabilities, verifying balances and following up on discrepancies with Accounting.
  • Support quarterly and year-end processes by gathering data, running preliminary reports, and assisting with W-2 review.
  • Maintain organized documentation for internal and external audit requests.

Process Improvement & Team Support

  • Document payroll procedures, update job aids, and maintain checklists to ensure consistency and accuracy in recurring tasks.
  • Recommend process improvements to reduce errors or improve efficiency.
  • Provide cross-training support to payroll staff and serve as backup on routine tasks when needed.

Core Competencies

Core Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of payroll regulations, wage attachments, and taxation, with experience supporting complex higher-education payroll environments.
  • Proficiency in Workday Payroll and familiarity with ADP SmartCompliance, including basic configuration, troubleshooting, and report execution.
  • Advanced attention to detail and analytical skills, with the ability to audit data, identify discrepancies, and support reconciliations.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain payroll concepts clearly and provide high-quality customer service.
  • Strong Excel capability (pivot tables, lookups, data validation) for payroll auditing and analysis.
  • Proven ability to maintain confidentiality, follow internal controls, and exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive information.
  • Collaborative team player who works well with HR, Accounting, Benefits, and campus departments to resolve issues and support payroll operations.
  • Adaptable and proactive, with a continuous improvement mindset and willingness to learn new systems and processes.

Minimum Requirements

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related field; an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience may be considered.
  • 3–5 years of payroll experience in a complex, multi-department organization; higher education experience preferred.
  • Knowledge of payroll regulations, multi-state taxation, wage garnishments, and statutory reporting requirements.
  • Experience using Workday Payroll or another enterprise-level payroll system; familiarity with ADP SmartCompliance is a plus.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and data validation.
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to identify discrepancies and support reconciliations.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information in accordance with university policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills for responding to employee inquiries and supporting campus partners.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$105,00-$115,000

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to lead the set-up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high-quality operational process for the tournament. This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.

We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large-scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament-time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
  • Act as the volunteer department’s main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and system simulations.
  • Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in-line with FIFA’s data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision-making.

Informações adicionais

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A idéia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A idéia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

-Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Why Join

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar Avaliação e Diagnóstico Nutricional Especializado
  • Realizar o diagnóstico nutricional para identificar carências nutricionais, alergias ou intolerâncias, comuns em pessoas com TEA.
  • Participar de reuniões de equipe e discussões de caso com profissionais da equipe multiprofissional;
  • Implementar estratégias para lidar com a seletividade alimentar severa e recusa alimentar, utilizando técnicas de aproximação gradativa dos alimentos.
  • Desenvolver plano alimentar individualizado baseado em evidências científicas, focando em nutrientes importantes para o desenvolvimento.
  • Abordar comportamentos repetitivos ou restrições alimentares, visando a melhoria da nutrição sem causar desconforto ou ansiedade.
  • Capacitar pais, familiares e cuidadores sobre as necessidades alimentares e como promover práticas alimentares saudáveis.
  • Utilizar abordagens para implementação da terapia alimentar
  • Implementar protocolos como o Food Chaining (Cadeia Alimentar) para introduzir novos alimentos de forma gradual, respeitando o limite sensorial do paciente.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a equipe multiprofissional a dessensibilização para que o usuário consiga tolerar, tocar, cheirar e, finalmente, provar novos alimentos.
  • Realizar oficinas culinárias ou grupos de apoio para ensinar formas criativas de preparar alimentos que o paciente costuma recusar
  • Monitorar deficiências de micronutrientes comuns em dietas restritivas e prescrever suplementação quando necessário.
  • Participar de reuniões com equipe multiprofissional para alinhar as estratégias de reforço positivo e manejo comportamental durante as refeições.
  • Realizar atendimentos e visitas domiciliares compartilhados com outros profissionais da equipe multiprofissional.
  • Garantir a qualidade do registro das atividades nos sistemas nacionais de informação da Atenção Especializada.

Qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Nutrição;
  • Especialização completana área ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Nutricionista.

Horário de Trabalho

20h semanais

Etapas de Seleção

  • Step 4: Entrevista Técnica e por Competências 4 Entrevista Técnica e por Competências

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

description:
RJ - Sr Consultant (Sr Full Stack Developer)

Date: Mar 3, 2026

Location: Rio de Janeiro, RJ, BR,

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

You’ll own the delivery lifecycle end-to-end — from architecture and design to production reliability, technical mentorship, and stakeholder alignment. We’re looking for someone who can turn complex requirements into secure, scalable, high‑quality software — and help the team grow in the process.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own architecture and design: create system diagrams, define functional and non-functional requirements (such as scalability, reliability, security and cost), and set integration standards.
  • Build and deliver using our technology stack (see below) with focus on quality, performance, and observability.
  • Lead initiatives: break down roadmaps, manage small to medium-sized projects, remove blockers, and ensure on‑time delivery.
  • Plan and prioritize: create execution plans, estimate effort, manage risks, and clearly communicate progress to stakeholders.
  • Drive engineering excellence: enforce automated testing (unit, integration, e2e), deep code reviews, branch and release standards, and code quality.
  • Document for scale: maintain architecture documents, ADRs, operational guides, and runbooks, ensuring traceability and clarity within agile processes and tools.
  • Client interaction: attend remote and in‑person meetings, capture requirements, discuss trade‑offs, and present solutions clearly.
  • Mentor others: guide mid‑level and junior developers, share best practices, lead tech talks, and promote a learning culture.
  • Partner management: coordinate third parties, validate deliverables, and ensure alignment with project goals.
  • Ensure production quality: validate system integrations, instrument logs, metrics, and tracing, define basic SLOs, and participate in post‑mortems.
  • Continuous learning: explore new technologies, identify process improvements, and propose architectural enhancements.
  • Administrative support: handle operational requests and be available for national or international travel when required.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field.
  • Experience: 7+ years of professional experience, including technical leadership on complex projects.
  • Stack: Backend (Java, Python and .Net Core), Frontend (Angular), Node.js, SQL, strong background in REST API development, microservices and event‑driven architectures.
  • Cloud: Hands‑on experience with AWS or Azure, IAM (Identity and Access Management), storage, managed services and observability.
  • Quality & DevOps: Test automation, Git, Gitflow, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, semantic versioning and promotion across environments.
  • Security & Reliability: Familiarity with OWASP Top 10, secret management, least privilege, basic hardening, and observability (logs, metrics, tracing).
  • Language: Advanced English (written and spoken, client‑facing).
  • Profile: Proactive, system thinker, fluent with modern frameworks and best practices in development, testing, and cloud operations.

Nice to have:

  • Postgraduate or Master’s degree.
  • IaC (Terraform) and platform engineering principles.
  • Multi‑cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cost/performance optimization.
  • Exposure to performance tuning, caching, messaging/queue systems (e.g., Kafka), and feature flag management.

description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us

SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean‑infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with Advancing our Core: continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably. Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Purpose

  • As a Business Data Analyst, you analyze and interpret complex data to provide actionable insights that support business decision‑making and strategy development. Work closely with stakeholders to identify data needs, create reports, and develop data models that drive business performance and optimize operational efficiency. Ensure data accuracy and contribute to the continuous improvement of data processes and tools.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze and interpret complex data sets to provide actionable insights that support business decision‑making and strategy development.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to identify business needs and data requirements, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and objectives.
  • Develop and maintain data models, dashboards, and reports, providing clear and concise visualizations that communicate key findings to stakeholders.
  • Ensure data accuracy and integrity by performing data validation, cleansing, and quality checks, maintaining high standards of data governance.
  • Extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from various sources into analytical tools, ensuring data is prepared and structured for analysis.
  • Identify trends, patterns, and anomalies within data sets, providing insights that drive business process improvements and operational efficiency.
  • Support the development and implementation of data‑driven strategies, working closely with business units to optimize performance and achieve key objectives.
  • Present findings and recommendations to senior management and stakeholders, translating complex data insights into understandable and actionable business terms.
  • Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies in data analytics, integrating new tools and methodologies to enhance analytical capabilities.
  • Provide training and support to team members and other departments on data analysis techniques and the use of analytical tools, fostering a data‑driven culture within the organization.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in data science, business analytics, computer science, statistics, or a related field is required. Certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, or Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) are highly recommended. Proficiency in data analysis, statistical tools, and business intelligence (BI) platforms is essential. A master’s degree in a related field is preferred but not mandatory.

Experience

  • Experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related field, with demonstrated expertise in analyzing business data to support decision‑making processes.
  • Proven experience in collecting, cleaning, and analyzing large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that drive business performance.
  • Strong technical background with hands‑on experience in using data analysis tools and languages such as SQL, Python, R, or Excel, and proficiency in business intelligence platforms like Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and implement data models, reports, and dashboards that provide actionable insights to stakeholders across the organization.
  • Experience in working closely with business units to understand their data needs, translating business requirements into data‑driven solutions that support strategic goals.
  • Proficiency in data visualization techniques, with the ability to present complex data in a clear and compelling manner to both technical and non‑technical audiences.
  • Knowledge of data governance, data quality management, and best practices for ensuring data integrity and accuracy across systems.
  • Strong problem‑solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify data‑related issues and recommend effective solutions to improve business processes.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross‑functional teams, including IT, finance, and operations, to support data‑driven initiatives.
  • Relevant certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, or Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) are preferred.

Functional Competencies

  • Compliance Governance
  • Risk and Control Analytics and reporting
  • IT Tools and application
  • Cost and budget control
  • Business Partnering
  • Digital savvy
  • Business Acumen
  • Contract Management
  • Management of change application

title: Security Investigator - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Security Investigator to join our Corporate Security Department (CSD).

CSD is responsible for providing highly specialized professional, investigative and consulting services to Saudi Aramco’s Corporate and Executive Management, in order to safeguard the Company and its communities.

Your primary role is to conduct Company based investigations, in respect of serious and complex issues, including, but not limited to fraud, business ethics, abuse of authority, conflict of interest, misuse of resources, harassment, crimes against the person, anti-social behavior, unsafe acts, cybersecurity and data leakage.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate, you will be required to perform the following:

  • Conduct and lead highly complex and sensitive misconduct investigations, in accordance with legal norms, with specific reference to and compliance with Saudi Labor Law and relevant Company Policies and Procedures.
  • Initiate, administer and plan investigations, and present the case findings to internal control organizations.
  • Provide regular briefings supported by detailed, evidential reports and information to Corporate and Executive Management, in addition to line management.
  • Perform interviews to identify and develop facts to resolve investigative issues and expediently prepare high quality, well-structured and evidential professional reports of investigation.
  • Identify, prevent and detect wrongdoing or offending
  • Provide misconduct and cybersecurity awareness programs throughout the Company.
  • Identify cost savings, reimbursements and recoveries in favor of Saudi Aramco arising from investigative findings and recommend relevant business change practices and lessons learned to mitigate and negate current and future risks.
  • Conduct detailed research (from open and closed sources) and crime pattern/risk analysis, to identify trends, hot spots, actual or potential corporate threats and vulnerabilities.
  • Maintain and organize investigation case files to a high quality and auditable standard in compliance with data protection norms.
  • Liaise with Company stakeholders and external parties as required, in progressing and reviewing investigative outcomes and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Coach and develop junior investigators and keep abreast of investigative techniques and legal norms.
  • You will hold a Bachelor’s degree in Criminal Justice, Criminology, Police Sciences or Security Studies. Degrees in the following disciplines are also acceptable: Business and Management, Computer & Information Systems, and Police Administration.
  • You will have nine (9) years of experience in law enforcement and/or corporate investigations with a proven ability in conducting complex cases of investigation, in respect of fraud, business ethics, abuse of authority, conflict of interest, misuse of resources, harassment, crimes against the person, anti-social behavior, unsafe acts, cybersecurity and data leakage etc.
  • You will be able to demonstrate excellent organizational, analytical and evidential skills, when conducting investigations and presenting relevant findings.
  • You must have excellent report writing skills and the ability to structure and summarize case findings in a concise, logical and articulate manner in compliance with legal norms.
  • You will be able to build effective work relationships in a diverse and multi-cultural environment is a necessity.
  • You will have a recognized professional certification, in related disciplines, such as a Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), Professional Certified Investigator (PCI), Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), International Compliance Association (ICA), Certified Forensic Interviewer (CFI) or equivalent.

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

  • Cross‑Team Collaboration: Brief Designers and Editors on the creation of assets including static ads, animations, mobile‑first videos, and storyboards for short‑form content. title: Scrum Master
description:
Que tal fazer parte do nosso time como Scrum Master?

Sua missão será atuar como facilitador da cultura ágil, promovendo a entrega contínua de valor por meio da aplicação de boas práticas de gestão de projetos e uso adequado de ferramentas utilizadas. Você apoiará as equipes na avaliação de demandas e recursos, acompanhará KPIs e OKRs, e atuará de forma consultiva junto a Product Owners e lideranças.

Essa é uma oportunidade no modelo híbrido no Rio de Janeiro.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

Como Scrum Master, você focará em:

  • Avaliar junto as gerências técnicas as demandas, viabilidade, alocação de recursos e cronogramas estratégicos.
  • Estabelecer e manter os padrões de gestão de projetos e métodos ágeis (Scrum, PMBOK etc.).
  • Garantir a utilização adequada das ferramentas (Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, GANTT CHART).
  • Implantar e monitorar KPIs e OKRs da área, promovendo gestão baseada em dados.
  • Atuar de forma consultiva e proativa junto aos Product Owners e líderes de tecnologia.
  • Promover iniciativas de inovação e transformação digital.
  • Buscar tendências, ferramentas e boas práticas de mercado aplicáveis à realidade da empresa.
  • Avaliar oportunidades de automação, inteligência de dados e eficiência operacional.
  • Estimular cultura de colaboração, autonomia, melhoria contínua e aprendizado.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

Como requisitos básicos, buscamos:

  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de projetos ágeis, preferencialmente Azure DevOps.
  • Conhecimento prático dos frameworks Scrum.
  • Vivência em Gestão de Projetos tradicional.
  • Capacidade de criar e interpretar métricas de desempenho ágil (burnup, burndown, velocity).
  • Certificação Scrum Master (CSM, PSM I ou equivalente).
  • Experiência com indicadores de performance.

Você se destaca se tiver:

  • Experiência no sistema Service Now.
  • Experiência com projetos de alta complexidade.
  • Certificações adicionais (Kanban KMP, SAFe, PMI-ACP).
  • Conhecimento de práticas DevOps.
  • Experiência em processos de transformação ágil em grandes organizações.

Se inscreva e embarque nessa jornada com a gente!

title: Software Developer
description:
Job Purpose

The Senior Software Developer calls for an experienced, knowledgeable, and talented individual to design and develop software for the User Configurable Open System (UCOS) product.

As a senior software engineer, you will have an opportunity to apply your versatile embedded, systems, and application software development skills to UCOS’s expanding use in myriad industrial controls and automation systems and Industrial IoT. You will lead and collaborate with other engineers while contributing at all phases of the software development lifecycle.

Job Description

  • Architect, design, implement, test, and deliver high-quality, performant software products.
  • Work cross-functionally with software, application, and quality engineers to ensure products meet engineering and client success criteria.
  • Actively participate in the definition and implementation of new processes and improvements.
  • Identify and create new technologies and ideas to increase the organization’s intellectual property and to better address customer needs.
  • Present your designs and solutions to internal and external teams and review designs of software and quality engineers.
  • Develop test plans and test automation processes to increase automated functional tests.
  • Mentor team members in development/test technologies, tools, and processes.
  • Location: Tech Center - Ilha do Fundão - RJ

You are meant for this job if:

  • Requires a Bachelor of Science degree or related field.
  • Expertise in software engineering.
  • Expert experience in C/C++, developing embedded software and systems software.
  • Deep knowledge of object-oriented programming and experience with at least one of (Java, C#, Python, Ruby).
  • Knowledge of containerization technologies (such as Docker), Kubernetes technologies (such as K3S, Helm charts, Rancher), and IoT protocols (MQTT, REST API, Kafka).
  • Knowledge of cloud technologies such as AWS.
  • Systems software programming knowledge of Windows and Linux OS.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft MFC (Microsoft Foundation Class), WPF, Qt, or similar GUI frameworks.
  • Understanding of database technologies such as SQL, ODBC, and relational database schema design.
  • Understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP), wired interfaces (Ethernet, USB), and wireless interfaces (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Cell, Satellite).
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining APIs for internal/external services.
  • Exposure to the principals of Industrial Protocols, Platforms, and APIs: OPC (DA & UA), Profibus, Profinet, Modbus (RTU, TCP, Enron), EtherIP, etc.
  • Exposure to serial communication protocols (I2C, RS-485, RS-232, CAN, SPI).
  • Exposure to industry standard embedded design and debugging tools is a plus (JTAG, protocol analyzers, emulators).
  • Knowledge of web technologies, such as JavaScript, CSS, HTML5, XML, JSON, and/or Ajax.
  • Exposure to Configuration Management tools (Version control, bug tracking, change management, automated builds, and coding standards).
  • Exposure to developing in agile and iterative software development processes.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
