title: Creator Manager
description:
Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

Darkroom is hiring a Creator Manager to lead client‑facing creator strategy and execution across our Creator Services division. This role owns the relationship between brands and our creator network - ensuring campaigns are strategically aligned, operationally sound, and performance‑driven across platforms, including TikTok Shop, Amazon affiliate, LTK, YouTube, and other emerging commerce channels.

As a Creator Manager, you will serve as the primary point of contact for both clients and creators. You will shape activation strategy, oversee execution, and ensure creator output drives measurable impact while maintaining a strong creator experience. If you thrive at the intersection of relationships, strategy, and commerce - this role was built for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Creator Strategy & Client Leadership: Lead creator and influencer strategy across client accounts, serving as the primary client‑facing point of contact - presenting strategy, performance insights, and optimization recommendations.
  • Campaign Execution: Own end‑to‑end execution of creator campaigns, including sourcing, vetting, contracting, onboarding, and performance tracking.
  • Platform Activation: Activate creators across TikTok Shop, affiliate programs, paid UGC, Amazon, LTK, YouTube, and other emerging channels.
  • Commerce & Creative Alignment: Partner with the Account team and Content Studio to align creator efforts to hero SKUs, commission strategy, and creative frameworks.
  • Performance Monitoring: Track campaign performance and proactively recommend optimization opportunities.
  • Network & Operations: Manage usage rights, timelines, deliverables, CRM systems, and Darkroom’s creator network infrastructure.
  • Team Development: Mentor junior team members and help scale best practices within Creator Services.

Who You Are

  • 3–6 years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, UGC, or affiliate programs.
  • Strong client management experience and comfort leading strategy conversations.
  • Deep understanding of creator workflows, usage rights, and cross‑platform activation.
  • Experience with TikTok Shop and affiliate models preferred; exposure to Amazon affiliate, LTK, or YouTube Shopping is a plus.
  • Analytical and performance‑oriented, with the ability to translate creator output into measurable impact.
  • Highly organized and confident managing multiple clients and creator pipelines simultaneously.
  • Strong communicator with a creator‑first mindset and commercial awareness.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote, employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model, including weekly in‑office appearances. Senior Procurement Delivery Manager, Brazil leads the Brazil regional procurement team. The individual will create and stand‑up the procurement organizational construct to support the growth of the region. They are the most senior procurement person in the region, and their team ensures regional procurement strategy, oversees purchasing processes, manages supplier relationships, mitigates risks while ensuring cost efficiency.

They integrate business strategies and demand through aligned procurement category strategies ensuring the delivery of commercial excellence, representing the ‘voice’ of the region for the end‑to‑end procurement process. They will liaise with other procurement teams to deliver the region’s priorities, e.g., working with categories when that category delivers into their region. They balance business needs with category plans ensuring they are in alignment.

In addition, they act as the main point of contact for external partners to procurement (PPSA, suppliers, co‑ventures, regulators, etc.), oversee cost recovery of third‑party spend and support business integrity and crisis activities to reduce operational risk and cost. Where applicable, they are a member of the Regional Business Leadership Team (BLT).

They are a people leader for the region overseeing people matters. They work with their peers to share ideal ways of working, making procurement more efficient and effective.

They cultivate partnerships with senior stakeholders and collaborate to deliver step changes in third‑party spend management. Their teams directly influence the business/entity financial plans and the overall value delivery of Finance – procurement. They have high commercial acumen ensuring alignment with business goals and delivering secure, optimal, compliant, competitive, and risk‑managed procurement outcomes, ensuring a safe, sustainable supply chain is in place.

A transformational leader, adept at change management, who builds high‑performing teams through emotional understanding and fostering resilience.

  • Delivers modernization & transformation activities, leading optimization of regional procurement delivery aligned to the broader procurement strategic transformation agenda.

  • Team leadership: Builds high‑performing teams by fostering a culture of collaboration, excellence, and continuous improvement. Their team has deep technical skills and represents the interests of the region across procurement and the broader organization.
  • Builds region knowledge across the wider procurement organization to ensure delivery of their objectives.
  • Develops the team’s technical capabilities and nurtures accelerator skills; curiosity in external markets, innovation and technological disruption, digital fluency, data‑driven insights, and strong collaboration with stakeholders.
  • Establishes an environment of psychological safety as a foundation for collaborative learning, ideation and innovation.
  • Provides coaching and guidance to their matrix teams and dotted‑line reports on business delivery, external stakeholder interface, risk management and people matters.
  • Promotes compliance with bp's Code of Conduct (CoC), policies and procedures to ensure compliance, actively demonstrates and role‑models bp’s Who We Are expectations.
  • Supplier & external relationship management: Uses storytelling to communicate with impact, respectfully challenging to achieve the right outcomes, resolving conflict and focusing on priorities.
  • Skilled at leading and influencing through complexity and ambiguity, managing virtual relationships in multi‑discipline, multi‑cultural environments.
  • Builds deep relationships, bringing market insights and championing supplier value whilst taking time to understand business needs. Becomes a trusted advisor and critical partner.

  • Uses digital tools to drive innovation and value creation.
  • Uses storytelling and good communication to encourage adoption.

Essential Candidate Requirements

  • Leadership and communication: Strong leadership, communication, and negotiation skills are essential for managing teams, relationships, and complex contracts. Influencing and integrating skills.
  • Experience: A minimum of 10+ years of professional experience in procurement or a related field, with specific experience in areas like government purchasing or local ordinances being a plus; especially given the need for PPSA engagement.
  • Technical skills: Proficiency with procurement and supply chain management software (e.g., SAP, ERP systems, etc.) and data analytics tools are frequently used to manage the procurement process within the organization. Established supply chain strategy for the region, including contract map.

Additional Beneficial but Not Essential

At bp, we provide an excellent working environment and employee benefits. We offer an open and inclusive culture and a great work‑life balance. Tremendous learning and development opportunities are available to craft a career path, life and health insurance, medical care package and many others!

We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

Risk Management unit Brazil is seeking a talented Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD)/ Process Safety Senior/Principal Consultant with a proven ability to tackle complex technical challenges, to join a fast-paced technical safety consultancy at the cutting edge of risk analysis techniques. This is a great opportunity to be part of a motivated team that is a trusted voice to tackle global transformations and challenges, helping our customers in achieving the safety of their assets and operations.

The Risk Management South America team provide a wide range of advisory safety engineering and risk management services to the energy industry, for CAPEX and OPEX projects, in Brazil and worldwide. The Senior/Principal Consultant is expected to liaise with and support several customers and stakeholders including regulatory agencies mainly in the upstream segments, but also in midstream and downstream segments, and tackle energy transition topics, such as BESS, CCS and Hydrogen.

The Senior/Principal Consultant reports to a Team Leader and has responsibility for technical delivery of projects with collaboration of other team members and has technical leadership of more junior consultants besides project management. The role includes customer interaction to find solutions to their challenges and discuss project schedule/delivery, technical issues and solutions. The Senior/Principal consultant will have opportunity to interact with customers and other offices globally.

What we offer

Job Overview

We are seeking a Safety Engineer to join the Saudi Aramco Loss Prevention organization (LP).

LP is responsible for providing both day-to-day in-field occupational and process safety support to Saudi Aramco operations, as well as centralized technical support and consulting function. Our field offices are located in Abqaiq, Riyadh, Ras Tanura, Dhahran, Udhailiyah, Jeddah (including Yanbu and Jazan), and Tanajib. Through these offices, LP provides its services to all Saudi Aramco facilities and departments that are located throughout the Kingdom.

Your primary is to provide daily support to company facilities and departments, help them to effectively implement the Saudi Aramco Safety Management System (Occupational & Process Safety) expectations and associated programs, as well as to assure compliance to all company safety requirements.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

description:
Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Technology

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

Reporting organizationally to the Senior Telecoms Manager, the Venue Telecom Manager (VTCM) will be a key member of the FIFA27 Technology team. The VTCM will work closely with the Technology teams in all the stadiums and IBCC and Zurich, as well as other stakeholders, to deliver critical Network and telecommunications solutions for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the planning, delivery, and operations of telecommunications infrastructure and services across competition and non‑competition venues, including:
  • Broadcast Contribution Network (BCN)
  • Event Network (WAN, MAN, LAN, WLAN, cabling, containment)
  • Internet, VLAN, VPN services, VoIP
  • Mobile Network and Private 5G
  • Push‑to‑Talk/Private Mobile Radios
  • Spectrum Management
  • CATV/IPTV
  • Rate Card services (Internet/IP Codecs)
  • Deploy and oversee technology services across various venues (stadia, training sites, operation centers, accreditation centers, ticketing centers, hotels, airports, and transport hubs).
  • Ensure compliance with FIFA standards in the integration of tournament technology services, such as Accreditation and Ticketing, with the FIFA Event Network environment.
  • Collaborate with Football Technology Innovation suppliers, media, broadcasters, and other functional stakeholders to define and fulfill network and cybersecurity requirements.
  • Coordinate on‑site IT and telecom technical teams for infrastructure testing, acceptance, and operations.
  • Manage incident resolution and ensure adherence to service‑level agreements (SLAs), escalating risks and issues to the Technology Command Center (TCC).
  • Support spectrum management efforts, including interference resolution in collaboration with regulatory authorities and venue teams.
  • Ensure timely and accurate reporting, including daily updates to the TCC and post‑event analysis.
  • Participate in pre‑tournament training, readiness exercises, and rehearsals.

Your Profile

Education

  • University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science, Telecommunications Engineering or related field

Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of IT/Technology experience, preferably in major events.
  • Strong knowledge of IT and telecommunications technologies, including CATV, AV systems, radio communications, VLANs and related areas.
  • Experience coordinating with diverse teams and managing vendor relationships.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Detail‑oriented and process‑driven with the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Effective communicator with strong interpersonal skills.
  • Prior experience in the Sports / major event industry is highly preferred.

Skills & Competencies

  • Manager with experience in similar projects.
  • Good knowledge of venue technology services across major sporting events.
  • Have up to date knowledge and project management expertise in all event related technologies, including all types of technology business solutions, community access TV (CATV), radio communications, wired communication, printing, broadcast contribution network, spectrum, audio and visual.
  • Ability to always maintain a professional demeanour. Consistently interacts professionally and works productively with all levels of employee.
  • Excellent cross group collaboration skills and demonstrated ability to lead virtual teams across groups, conflict management and driving consensus to deliver on program milestones.
  • Good Leadership skills and able to manage and motivate other team members.
  • Highly adept at consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to adapt speech to audience coming from a broad spectrum of disciplines and with various levels of technical knowledge.
  • Leadership and accountability across all areas of relevance.
  • Strong political acumen and adaptable to a wide range of working environments.

Certifications & Requirements

Various

Desde dezembro de 2024 a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Cardoso Fontes .

O Hospital Cardoso Fontes, é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro. A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Acompanhar e fiscalizar as rotinas de manutenção preventiva/corretiva e calibrações de equipamentos dos prestadores nas Unidades de Saúde;
  • Auxiliar na programação dos serviços referentes a pequenas instalações, serviços de manutenção ou melhoria nas instalações;
  • Indicar novos materiais de manutenção para inclusão nos itens de estoque e sistema de compras;
  • Realizar as atividades seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição;
  • Elaborar pareceres técnicos sobre propostas de consertos e investimentos;
  • Elaborar descrição técnica de equipamentos e acessórios;
  • Elaborar planilhas técnicas em geral;
  • Realizar suporte técnico para as unidades de saúde;
  • Participar da elaboração de Planos de investimentos e especificações técnicas;
  • Elaborar e aplicar treinamentos de manuseio de equipamentos médicos hospitalares;
  • Solicitar Laudos de Inservibilidade para os prestadores de serviços;
  • Realizar visitas às Unidades de Saúde para avaliação técnica-operacional dos equipamentos;
  • Classificar Ordens de Serviços recebidas por prioridade de atendimento;
  • Executar relatórios de visitas técnicas com fotográficas e conclusões;
  • Acompanhar e avaliar instalações de novos equipamentos nas Unidades;
  • Elaborar relatórios para subsidiar a Engenharia nas reuniões de alinhamento com os prestadores de serviços;
  • Participar de avaliações de adequações físicas em unidades de saúde e novos projetos;
  • Monitorar os atendimentos das O.S corretivas abertas no sistema de gerenciamento;
  • Executar relatórios técnicos das atividades realizadas;
  • Atender a todos os princípios e critérios de conduta contidos no Manual de Conformidade Administrativa-Políticas e Princípios de Integridade da SPDM;
  • Executar as atribuições determinadas pela Instituição a respeito das práticas a serem tomadas em relação à proteção de dados pessoais-LGPD;
  • Realizar as atividades das áreas/setores, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição.

Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino Médio Completo. Curso de Técnico Completo em Equipamentos Biomédicos, Eletrônicos, Eletrotécnica, Mecânico ou Mecatrônica. Registro ativo no CREA ou CFT. Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Técnico de Manutenção Hospitalar.

Informações adicionais

Local: Jacarepaguá/RJ
Escala: 12x36
Horário: 07:00 - 19:00 e 19:00 - 07:00

At Dover Fueling Solutions (DFS), we are taking fueling and convenience retail to the next level. We are passionate about cultivating excellence in everything we do, but what really fuels us is our people. They’re the heart of our company. As an employee, our promise to you is that you’ll work on new and innovative products and solutions, be mentored by managers and teammates who are collaborative, caring, and act with integrity, and have the opportunity to grow in ways that are meaningful to you. Unique and interesting projects – both locally and globally – will challenge you and allow you to pursue different and rewarding career paths.

We are #EnergizedByGrowth.

DFS is part of a legacy of leadership that spans back generations, made up of some of the most trusted, leading-edge brands in the industry. As part of Dover Corporation and with our talented, innovative, outstanding people, we are doing great things and redefining what is possible in fueling and convenience retail. Providing advanced fuel-dispensing equipment, including clean energy solutions, systems and payment, automatic tank gauging and wet stock-management solutions, DFS comprises the product brands of Wayne Fueling Systems, OPW Fuel Management Systems, ClearView, Tokheim, ProGauge, Fairbanks, LIQAL, AvaLAN, and Bulloch Technologies. Headquartered in Austin, TX, DFS has a significant technology development and manufacturing presence worldwide, including facilities in Brazil, China, India, Italy, Poland, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and the United States.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Senior Manager, Human Resources LATAM serves as a strategic and tactical business partner to the LATAM team, driving the execution of HR strategies for the region. Reporting to the Director, Human Resources EMEA & SAL and based out of our factory in Rio de Janeiro, this role oversees all aspects of HR—including talent acquisition, compensation and benefits, learning and development, talent management, employee relations, policy design, and HR operations.

Operating as a primary business partner for the Rio manufacturing site and the wider regional business, the Senior Manager fosters a high-performance, employee-centric culture. This role emphasizes quality, productivity, and empowerment while ensuring all HR initiatives are aligned with global, regional, and local strategies to drive business success.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Strategic HR Leadership & Business Partnership
    • Provide HR leadership and functional support across multiple departments, including Operations, Sourcing, Sales, Customer Service, and Legal.
    • Ensure HR strategies are effectively aligned with business priorities, fostering an adaptable and high-performing workforce.
    • Provide expert consultation to managers and senior leaders on HR-related matters.
    • Collaborate across departments to ensure a seamless employee experience and a strong people strategy.
  • Partner with leadership and regional Talent Development to counsel on employee impact decisions, supporting workforce planning, succession, and development initiatives.
  • Lead efforts to enhance talent mobility and strengthen leadership capabilities within the organization.
  • Manage talent engagement processes, including recruitment, compensation, promotions, training, and performance management, in partnership with the local HR team.
  • Support global mobility for key employees, collaborating with global mobility teams and HR peers.
  • Employee Engagement and culture
    • Cultivate a high-performance, inclusive work environment that aligns with Dover values and DFS’ company culture.
    • Support initiatives that enhance employee engagement, workplace satisfaction, and long-term retention.
  • Consult with business leaders to drive organizational design, change management, and leadership development strategies.
  • Diagnose workforce gaps and design solutions for regional and local implementation.
  • Oversee succession planning processes, fostering leadership development and career progression for key talent.
  • HR Operations, compliance & leadership
    • Manage, guide, and mentor HR team members based in Rio de Janeiro.
    • Ensure compliance with local labor laws and global HR requirements.
    • Develop and implement HR policies and procedures, ensuring alignment with corporate guidelines.
    • Monitor and manage key HR metrics, providing data-driven insights for business decisions.

CANDIDATE EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

The ideal candidate will bring strategic HR leadership at both local and regional levels, with experience in fast-paced, evolving business environment.

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources management or business administration.
  • Experience in partnering with senior leadership teams.
  • Experience in multiple locations.
  • Fluent Portuguese and English language skills, both verbal and written, Spanish is a preference.
  • Exceptional critical thinking skills: ability to decompose complex problems, prioritize issues, and implement sensible solutions.
  • Track record of creating strong partnerships and influencing at all levels of the organization.
  • Superior interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to increase productivity and continuously improve methods, approaches.
  • Experience in organizational development and change management.
  • Proven ability to work in a fluid, fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality.

Company Description

M3 USA is at the forefront of healthcare innovation, offering digital solutions across healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, and more. Since our inception in 2000, we’ve seen remarkable growth, fueled by our mission to utilize the internet for a healthier world and more efficient healthcare systems.

Our success is anchored in our trusted digital platforms that engage physician communities globally, facilitating impactful medical education, precise job placement, and insightful market research. M3 USA prides itself on a dynamic and innovative work environment where every team member contributes to global health advancements.

Joining M3 USA means being part of a dedicated team striving to make a significant difference in healthcare. We provide a unique opportunity for you to be at the cutting edge of healthcare innovation, shaping the future in a meaningful career. Embrace the chance to drive change with M3 USA.

About the Business Unit

M3 Global Research, part of M3 Inc., provides the most comprehensive and highest quality market research recruitment and support services available to the industry with relationships reaching respondents in more than 70 countries worldwide.

M3 Global Research maintains ISO 20252 and 27001 certifications with the highest quality data collection and project management capabilities that cover the spectrum of quantitative and qualitative techniques utilized today. M3 services incorporate all of the most advanced statistical and attitudinal methodologies allowing clients to provide world‑class offerings and support services to their end‑client customers throughout multiple industry sectors.

Job Description

The Mission

The mission of the Quantitative Project Manager is to be a communication and relationship liaison between M3, our clients, and other teams involved in the project’s completion. You will directly manage all aspects of each project on time and within budget. This is the ideal role for someone who has experience in international online market research specifically focused on healthcare, sampling, survey recruitment, and collaboration with all teams involved in the project.

Duties include

  • Manage international quantitative market research projects through entire project life cycle including all aspects of managing clients, partners, healthcare professional sample, and consumer sample.
  • Work directly with various teams to setup and test survey links and redirects, prepare and send sample, conduct quality/audit checks, managing respondent inquiries and honorarium and all other components of online research.
  • Coordinate and lead project kickoff meetings for all assigned studies to ensure all involved parties understand project specifications, client needs, timelines, and responsibilities.
  • Manage and leverage relationships with vendors to facilitate accurate and timely deliverables, communications, and issue resolution.
  • Monitor productivity and quality of data collection to produce regular updates and progress reports on project status.
  • Manage study profitability by monitoring and accounting for all project costs affecting the budget.
  • Partner with sales team members and operations staff to address issues and/or make recommendations to improve performance on research studies.
  • Work independently to support international teams outside of normal US business hours.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience preferred.
  • The candidate must have at least 2-3 years’ experience in market research project management, preferably in the medical/healthcare field.
  • The candidate must be a self‑motivated individual with exceptional time management, organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • The candidate must have well‑developed analytical and problem‑solving skills; ability to quickly solve problems as they present as well as proactively identify and resolve potential issues to avoid escalation. The candidate must have the ability to work autonomously and in a team environment to successfully meet study specific and departmental objectives.
  • The candidate must have basic math skills and be able to calculate incidence rate, response rate, honoraria amounts, profit, etc.
  • The candidate must have very strong Microsoft Office skills including Excel, Outlook and Word, and be a quick learner of new technologies/software.
  • The candidate must have exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • The candidate must have the ability to manage multiple online research projects accurately and on‑time in a fast‑paced environment where moving deadlines and other changes often occur in real time.

Additional Information

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. Canonical is a globally distributed team of engineers who share that passion, and you will need to work well in that context. Engineers who thrive at Canonical are mindful of the dynamics of the open source ecosystem, and equally aware of the needs of large, innovative organizations.

This job involves international travel several times a year, usually for one week at a time.

Location

This role will be based remotely in EMEA or the Americas regions.

  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Develop and maintain software for delivery, operations and life-cycle management of Ceph storage

  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree

  • You have experience with Ceph storage

  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have interest and experience with two or more of the following: Linux, Kubernetes, Public cloud, OpenStack, LXC/LXD, Python, Go, Debian packaging
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Experience operating Ceph clusters in production
  • Experience with open source distributed storage such as Gluster, Minio, Mayastor or similar

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Basic Function

As an integral part of the Department of Dermatology, the Administrative Coordinator provides a range of administrative support to the Department Chair and multiple faculty in the Department of Dermatology at Howard University. Responsibilities include assisting with daily administrative operations, coordinating and scheduling complex appointments and meetings, coordinating travel and preparing associated materials, preparing correspondence, compiling data, coordinating special projects and events, and records maintenance. This position will be responsible for monitoring departmental academic and research budgets and business affairs, personnel matters and interpreting policy and procedures. The position will perform duties of a sensitive and confidential nature. Incumbents typically work at a high degree of independence with general direction and supervision received from the Department Chair.

Supervisory Accountability

Responsible for orienting and training other administrative hires, as needed in the future. May also be responsible for acting in a “lead” or “senior” capacity over clerical positions performing essentially the same work, or related technical tasks.

Nature And Scope

The principal duties and responsibilities of the Administrative Coordinator include, but are not limited to: Compose and prepare correspondence as well as assist in writing and preparation of manuscripts, grants, questionnaires, journal reviews, presentations, reports, letters, and memos for the Chair’s review and signature. Read email and coordinate office communications ensuring timeliness and accuracy. Screen and provide telephone coverage for the Chair, Faculty, and administrative offices. Represent the Chair in meetings, take dictation, minutes, notes and prepare final copy for review and arrange department meetings. Create graphic brochures, posters, signs, labels for conferences, newsletters, invitations and presentation slides for the department. Assist the Chair with activities relating to the University/College of Medicine, the Faculty Practice Plan (FPP), and the Hospital (HUH).

  • Assist and submit Attending Physicians OPPE and FPPE.

  • Facilitate Attending Physicians and staff computer, printer issues.
  • Maintain Attending Physicians on-call schedule.
  • Order Dermatology office supplies / furniture.
  • Manage vendor relationships and contracts for hardware, software, equipment and services.
  • Coordination of purchase and maintenance of departmental equipment and licensing agreements.
  • Manage overall department appearance: painting, seasonal decorations.
  • Coordinate departmental fundraiser(s) and annual alumni donation campaign.
  • Maintain accurate alumni contact list.
  • Coordinate physician attendance at community health fairs.
  • Create and disseminate quarterly departmental alumni newsletter.
  • Maintain and distribute Attending Physicians license and malpractice insurance status.
  • Facilitate hiring and on boarding of new faculty.
  • Schedule meetings for Chair and faculty.

  • Assist with maintenance of departmental PR initiatives and social media platforms.

Core Competencies

title: TERAPEUTA OCUPACIONAL - CEDTEA - AP 3.3
description:
A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver ações intersetoriais, mantendo a integração com a rede de suporte social, fortalecendo e implementando as ações na comunidade.
  • Utilizar instrumentos validados para rastreio e acompanhamento, como o Perfil Sensorial 2, SPM (Sensory Processing Measure), e escalas de desenvolvimento (Bayley, Denver II) ou específicas para TEA (como auxílio no fechamento de diagnóstico via ADOS-2 ou CARS).
  • Analisar o desempenho em Atividades de Vida Diária (AVDs) — como comer, vestir-se e tomar banho — e Atividades Instrumentais (AIVDs).
  • Avaliar hiper ou hiporreatividade tátil, auditiva, visual, vestibular e proprioceptiva que impactam o comportamento e a aprendizagem.
  • Planejar e executar sessões baseadas na Teoria de Integração Sensorial de Ayres, utilizando equipamentos suspensos e estímulos controlados para organizar o sistema nervoso central do paciente.
  • Criar estratégias (uso de pistas visuais, encadeamento de tarefas) para que o paciente ganhe autonomia em higiene, alimentação e vestuário.
  • Realizar em conjunto com a equipe multiprofissional o Manejo da Seletividade Alimentar.
  • Promover o Desenvolvimento de Habilidades Motoras focando na motricidade fina (preensão para escrita, uso de tesoura) e coordenação óculo-manual.
  • Prescrever e confeccionar recursos de Tecnologia Assistiva.
  • Orientar a família e a escola sobre como organizar o ambiente para reduzir a sobrecarga sensorial (ajuste de iluminação, redução de ruídos, zonas de calma).
  • Realizar o acolhimento e a orientação parental, ajudando os cuidadores a compreenderem o processamento sensorial do filho e a aplicar estratégias de manejo em casa.
  • Elaborar relatórios detalhados para o Plano de Atendimento Individualizado (PAI) ou Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI) nas escolas, sugerindo adaptações curriculares e ambientais.
  • Emitir pareceres técnicos para fins de direitos (como o BPC ou solicitações judiciais para planos de saúde/SUS).
  • Realizar atendimentos e visitas domiciliares compartilhados com profissionais da equipe multiprofissional.
  • Elaborar projetos terapêuticos singulares em conjunto com profissionais da equipe multiprofissional, desenvolvendo a responsabilidade compartilhada.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Terapia Ocupacional.
  • Especialização completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Neurofuncional, Traumato-ortopedica, Estratégia Saúde da Família, Saúde Pública ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde.
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Terapeuta Ocupacional.

Informações adicionais

Local: Irajá

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

SOBRE NÓS

Fundado por portugueses nos anos 50 com o nome “Casas Guanabara”, o pequeno comércio se transformou no Supermercados Guanabara, uma das mais tradicionais e modernas redes do país. Atualmente possui 28 lojas distribuídas no Rio, Grande Rio, Baixada Fluminense e Região Metropolitana, dois centros de distribuição e dois depósitos.

Para garantir a melhor experiência de compras para os seus clientes, prezando pelo conforto e segurança, as unidades contam com piso antiderrapante, rampas de acesso para facilitar a circulação, corredores amplos, grande quantidade de check‑outs, estacionamento inteligente, além de um mix diferenciado para atender a qualquer orçamento.

E não para por aí! A rede de Supermercados Guanabara seguindo a tendência mundial do setor supermercadista implantou nas lojas a captação da água da chuva e do sistema de ar‑condicionado, com reúso nos banheiros e lavagem das lojas. A iluminação tem a tecnologia LED e um projeto arquitetônico que inclui fachada de vidro para evitar o desperdício de energia.

Você sabia que a rede inovou e levou o shopping para dentro do supermercado? Atualmente várias unidades Guanabara possui centro comercial com lojas de serviço e grandes magazines. Algumas lojas operam com sistema store in store, orientação de sommelier na hora da escolha de vinhos.

O Guanabara também inovou no calendário varejista do estado do Rio de Janeiro e criou campanhas promocionais como: Semana da Beleza, Semana da Limpeza, Guanababy, Black Fraldas e o tradicional Aniversário Guanabara!

A rede já foi eleita pela revista Veja Rio como "A marca mais amada do Rio" e por 15 anos pela pesquisa “Marcas dos Cariocas”, em parceria com O Globo, a "Marca preferida dos Cariocas" .

E você sabe qual o segredo de todo esse sucesso? São os 14 mil talentos que compõem esse time campeão.

Requisitos:

  • Formação: Curso técnico em enfermagem completo.
  • Registro no COREN RJ ativo e em regularidade.
  • Desejável vivência nas rotinas da internação.

Atividades:

  • Apresentar-se aos pacientes sob sua responsabilidade no início do plantão, prestando todas as informações necessárias a continuidade de seu atendimento.
  • Assumir as funções inerentes ao Técnico de Enfermagem Diarista na ausência do mesmo, visando dar continuidade e encaminhamento ao expediente do Setor.
  • Cumprir as orientações definidas em prescrição Médica, para preparo dos pacientes para realização de exames e/ou cirurgias, tais como manutenção de jejum, preparo de cólon, entre outros, a fim de garantir a continuidade do tratamento.
  • Observar previsões de altas e possíveis transferências, com objetivo de priorizar os cuidados, agilizando o processo.
  • Instalar no paciente os equipamentos de monitorização, como bombas infusoras e monitores cardíacos, conforme orientação médica.
  • Preparar corpo do paciente nos casos de óbito, a fim de encaminhá-lo ao Morgue.
  • Realizar a aplicação de compressas quentes e frias, conforme prescrição médica, assegurando a integridade cutânea do paciente.
  • Devolver medicações e materiais do cliente em caso de altas, transferências, óbitos ou em caso de modificações de prescrições, todos devidamente identificados com etiqueta do cliente.
  • Providenciar a devolução dos medicamentos e materiais não utilizados pelos pacientes, fazendo lançamento através do Sistema Phostos, garantindo a confirmação do processo.
  • Checar e rubricar todos os medicamentos prescritos e administrados, lançando no balanço hídrico horário de início de dieta, transporte de soluções, infusões, medicações SOS e ACM, assim como valor de glicemia, diurese e eliminações, controlar o balanço hídrico rigorosamente.
  • Verificar, os pacientes em precaução de contato, assegurando o bloqueio de entrada, com uso correto e rigoroso de EPIs.
  • Auxiliar os pacientes na ingestão de alimentos, quando necessário.
  • Conferir e testar equipamentos e/ou materiais dos boxes/quartos, sob sua responsabilidade, verificando o perfeito estado de funcionamento e utilização dos mesmos, quando da entrada de novos pacientes.
  • Admitir o paciente junto ao enfermeiro, realizando conferência dos sinais vitais, identificando o cliente com pulseira.
  • Remover todo material e equipamentos, realizar a higiene dos mesmos e armazená-los em local adequado, em caso de altas, transferências e óbitos.
  • Informar ao enfermeiro plantonista, problemas com equipamentos para que sejam comunicados aos serviços de apoio (engenharia clínica, hotelaria, manutenção predial, supervisão da higiene).
  • Preencher livro de protocolo, no plantão noturno, em caso de empréstimos de equipamento e/ou materiais para outros Setores de Enfermagem.

Outras informações:

  • Local de trabalho: Barra da Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro – RJ.
  • Escala de trabalho: À combinar.
  • Disponibilidade para treinamento.

title: Strategy Consultant Sr
description:
Por que a Valtech? Somos uma experience innovation company — um parceiro de confiança para as marcas mais reconhecidas do mundo. Para quem faz parte da Valtech, oferecemos oportunidades de crescimento, uma cultura guiada por valores, carreiras internacionais e a chance de moldar o futuro das experiências.

A oportunidade

Na Valtech, você encontra um ambiente projetado para aprendizado contínuo, impacto significativo e crescimento profissional. Seja criando novas soluções digitais, desafiando padrões ou construindo a próxima geração de experiências para clientes, seu trabalho ajudará a transformar indústrias.

Nós Temos Orgulho Em Anunciar

  • O trabalho que fazemos e a inovação que fomentamos
  • Nossos valores: Compartilhar, Cuidar e Ousar
  • Um ambiente de trabalho que fomenta a criatividade, diversidade e autonomia
  • Nossa estrutura global e sem fronteiras permite uma colaboração perfeita

A vaga

Como Strategy Consultant Sr , você é apaixonado por inovação em experiência e motivado a expandir os limites do que é possível. Você traz 5+ anos de experiência, mentalidade de crescimento e vontade de gerar impacto real.

Você Vai Se Destacar Nesta Função Se For

  • Uma pessoa curiosa, com vontade de melhorar processos e buscar novas soluções
  • Colaborativo, que valoriza trabalho em equipe e troca de conhecimento
  • Motivado pela interseção entre tecnologia, criatividade e dados
  • Familiarizado com metodologias Ágeis e consultoria (um diferencial)

Responsabilidades do cargo

Atuação estratégica em projetos digitais com foco em CRM, automação de marketing, conteúdo e experiência do usuário. O profissional será responsável por conectar times de negócios, marketing e tecnologia para impulsionar performance e valor percebido pelo cliente.

  • Desenho de jornadas omnichannel para públicos estratégicos (profissionais de saúde), com segmentação, testes A/B, personalização e foco em performance;
  • Facilitação de sessões de discovery e consultoria estratégica, transformando objetivos de negócio em planos táticos mensuráveis;
  • Pesquisa de benchmarks, definição de storytelling e construção de casos de uso com visão analítica e criativa, documentados em plataformas como Miro;
  • Criação de briefings completos e suporte à validação de materiais criativos, assegurando aderência à estratégia e consistência da narrativa;
  • Análise de resultados e geração de insights, propondo otimizações contínuas e evolução da régua de comunicação;
  • Apoio ao roadmap e à implementação técnica, garantindo que entregas estejam alinhadas à visão estratégica e às metas de negócio;
  • Suporte à gestão de projetos: documentação, cronogramas, estimativas de esforço, propostas comerciais e apresentações executivas.

Requisitos obrigatórios

Para ser considerado para esta vaga, você deve atender aos seguintes requisitos essenciais:

  • Experiência com Salesforce CRM
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 3 dias remoto e 2 dias presenciais no cliente (Jacarepaguá - RJ)
  • Upper-intermediate/Advanced English level

Se não atender a todos os requisitos, ainda assim o incentivamos a inscrição. Na Valtech, valorizamos perfis diversos e vontade de aprender.

Nosso compromisso com todas as pessoas

Criamos experiências que atendem diferentes perfis de pessoas — e isso também vale para o nosso time. Na Valtech, buscamos manter um ambiente inclusivo, onde todos tenham o apoio necessário para crescer e desenvolver seu potencial. Valorizamos a diversidade de trajetórias e perspectivas. Se quiser conhecer mais sobre nossas iniciativas, acesse nosso site Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site.

Os benefícios

Esta é uma posição CLT/PJ no BRASIL - Rio de Janeiro .

Além de um pacote de compensação competitivo, oferecemos:

  • Flexibilidade com trabalho híbrido
  • Oportunidades de crescimento, mobilidade internacional e programas de desenvolvimento
  • Aprendizado contínuo, com ferramentas modernas, treinamentos e especialistas da indústria

Os benefícios variam conforme a localidade. Seu Talent Partner fornecerá os detalhes durante o processo.

Seu processo de candidatura

Após enviar sua candidatura, o time de Talent Acquisition revisará seu perfil. Se suas habilidades e experiência estiverem alinhadas, entraremos em contato para os próximos passos.

Seu CV deve destacar experiências e conhecimentos relevantes. Não solicitamos informações como idade, gênero, estado civil ou foto. Avaliamos candidatos com base em habilidades, experiência e potencial.

⚠️ Atenção: esteja alerta para possíveis fraudes de recrutamento. Utilizamos apenas e-mails oficiais da Valtech.

Se você necessita de adaptações no processo seletivo, basta indicar na aplicação ou informar ao seu Talent Partner.

Sobre a Valtech

A Valtech é a experience innovation company que existe para desbloquear novas formas de experienciar o mundo.

Nós combinamos diferentes práticas, setores e culturas para ajudar marcas a gerar valor em um mundo digital.

Na interseção entre dados, IA, criatividade e tecnologia, impulsionamos transformação para organizações líderes como L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen, Dolby e outras.

Na Valtech, não apenas falamos sobre transformação, nós fazemos acontecer.

E nossas pessoas são o centro desse impacto, em um ambiente criado para que possam crescer, inovar e prosperar.

Quer fazer parte do próximo capítulo? Venha para a Valtech.

title: Software Engineer - Future Opportunities
description:
Voldex is a leading gaming company focused on Roblox, the most exciting ecosystem in gaming today. We are home to several of Roblox's top games, including Brookhaven, Driving Empire, and NFL Universe Football. With over 160 million monthly active players across our games, we are the #1 Roblox developer by audience size. Founded in 2015, we have since grown to 85+ full-time remote team members across the globe.

Our strategy is to acquire and sustainably grow games on Roblox. Our acquisition strategy is backed with significant capital from firms including The Raine Group, Makers Fund, Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), QIA, Dune Ventures, and MIT.

Our top games

  • Brookhaven, #1 Roleplay game on Roblox and the most popular game on the Roblox platform
  • Driving Empire, the #1 Driving game on Roblox where we’ve brought real cars into the game in partnership with automakers
  • NFL Universe Football, the #1 American football game and top grossing sports game on Roblox.

Join our Talent Pool!

At Voldex, we build games that reach millions of players around the world every single day. From genre-defining roleplay worlds to competitive sports experiences, we sit at the intersection of live operations, product velocity, and creator culture.

This is an evergreen posting for Software Engineers.

We’re always excited to connect with strong engineers who are passionate about Roblox and live game development. By applying to this role, you’re expressing interest in joining our engineering talent community. While we may not have an immediate opening that matches your profile, we review applications on an ongoing basis and may reach out as future roles open across our teams.

If building at scale on Roblox excites you - we’d love to hear from you!

What You’ll Do

  • Build and launch features that delight millions of players daily
  • Write clean, performant, and maintainable Roblox Lua code
  • Partner closely with designers, artists, and producers to craft compelling gameplay experiences
  • Debug, optimize, and improve live game systems
  • Elevate the technical quality and performance of our games
  • Playtest regularly and provide thoughtful design and product feedback

Our engineers don’t just ship code — they help shape the player experience.

Who You Are

  • Strong foundation in CS fundamentals and problem-solving
  • Familiarity with game engines, scripting languages, version control
  • Excellent communication and collaborative mindset
  • 1+ years of Roblox development experience

Nice to Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in CS/Software Engineering or equivalent development experience
  • Experience working in game teams
  • Shipped games or features on Roblox or similar platforms
  • Game jam or modding experience
  • Familiarity with live game systems (analytics, economy tuning, balancing)
  • 2+ years professional software development experience

Tech Stack

  • Roblox Lua scripting
  • Analytics pipelines (Snowflake, Tableau)
  • Collaboration tools: GitHub, Discord

What This Means

This posting is part of our long-term hiring strategy.

By submitting your application

  • You’re joining our engineering talent pool
  • We may reach out for exploratory conversations
  • You may be considered for future openings across our game teams

We’re building for the long game — and that includes building relationships with great engineers early! Let’s connect.

Voldex is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation - above-market salary + profit sharing + stock options
  • ⛳️ Retirement benefits - company contribution to your retirement plan (401k, RRSP, Pension), in Canada, UK and USA!

Hydro Energia é uma empresa integrada de alumínio e energia com presença global, incluindo o Brasil. A Hydro Energia atua como uma comercializadora independente de energia elétrica, oferecendo serviços como gestão e otimização de portfólio de energia, consultoria regulatória e comercial, além de operações estruturadas no mercado de energia. No Brasil, a empresa tem escritórios em Belém e no Rio de Janeiro e é uma das maiores operadoras no mercado livre de energia no Norte do país. Aqui fazemos mais do que conectar energia: conectamos ideias, inovação e sustentabilidade. Nosso compromisso é construir um futuro energético mais eficiente, sustentável e inteligente.

O que oferecemos a você

Salário competitivo, com um pacote abrangente de benefícios, garantindo que você seja recompensado pelas suas contribuições.
A oportunidade de se juntar a equipes diversas em uma empresa líder global em alumínio e energias renováveis que está mudando o jogo do alumínio.
Um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, criativo, com projetos globais e ambições sustentáveis.
Oportunidade de moldar a função e crescer na carreira por meio do desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal.
Você será parte de um negócio para o futuro juntando-se a nós em uma jornada transformadora.

O que você fará

Irá atuar no Trading de Energia, com responsabilidade direta pelo portfolio proprietário. A posição combina visão de mercado e fundamentos, execução e gestão de risco, com autonomia para propor estratégias e suportardecisões, através deanálises claras e consistentes.

  • Definir e executar estratégias proprietárias de trading com foco em retorno ajustado a risco;
  • Garantir o enquadramento das operações aos mandatos e limites de risco operacionais;
  • Executar operações de compra e venda no mercado livre, definindo estratégia de execução e gestão de liquidez;
  • Monitorar e interpretar drivers de preço, traduzindo fundamentos em alocação de risco;
  • Desenvolver relacionamento comercial com contrapartes, identificando oportunidades e assegurando liquidez;
  • Reportar estratégias, riscos e resultados de forma clara e objetiva.

O que fará você ter sucesso?

Formação Acadêmica

  • Superior Completo em Engenharia, Administração, Economia ou Exatas;
  • Especializações ou certificações em Finanças serãoum diferencial.

Conhecimentos e Habilidades

  • Experiência sólida em trading de energia ou commodities, com histórico em tomada de risco e execução;
  • Forte capacidade analítica com base em modelagem de preços, probabilidade e análise de cenários;
  • Disciplina e pragmatismo na alocação e gestão de riscos;
  • Capacidade de construir ferramentas de apoio a decisão;
  • Inglês avançado para conversação, escrita e leitura;
  • Desejável conhecimento de programação e análise de dados aplicadas a trading (ex. Python, SQL, automações, backtesting, etc).
  • Habilidades comerciais de comunicação, negociação e relacionamento;
  • Capacidade de interpretar cenários complexos e tomar decisão sob incerteza;
  • Controle emocional, humildade e senso de responsabilidade;
  • Raciocínio crítico, curiosidade e aprendizado rápido.

A Hydro valoriza diversas habilidades e perspectivas entre os empregados. Encorajamos todas as pessoas qualificadas a se inscreverem. Os perfis aderentes serão considerados independentemente de raça, religião, nacionalidade, etnia, idade, gênero, identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual ou deficiência. Nós nos esforçamos para oferecer oportunidades iguais para que todos possam contribuir e ter sucesso conosco.

Atuação na Hydro Energia (Rio de Janeiro/RJ).

Por mais de um século, nossas pessoas têm sido a base para a solução de alguns dos problemas mais desafiadores do mundo – e queremos que você se junte a nós para resolver os desafios do próximo século. Seja trabalhando em busca de soluções inovadoras para os resíduos da produção de alumínio, seja garantindo processos eficientes de energia renovável para a descarbonização em toda a cadeia, suas contribuições têm um impacto em nosso objetivo comum de impulsionar nossas indústrias e o mundo para um futuro mais verde.

Uma parte fundamental do sucesso nesta missão envolve a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho onde nossas diferenças são reconhecidas como nossa maior vantagem competitiva. Sua contribuição com uma perspectiva diversificada nos fortalece e, por meio de nosso programa global de diversidade, inclusão e pertencimento, podemos oferecer a você um local de trabalho inclusivo e de alto desempenho, onde todos se sentem valorizados.

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970. A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão. A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação. Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental. Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Utilizar testes (como a BPM – Bateria Psicomotora) para avaliar tonicidade, equilíbrio, lateralização, noção de corpo, estruturação espaço-temporal e praxia global/fina.
  • Identificar como a criança processa estímulos do ambiente e como isso afeta sua organização motora e emocional.
  • Auxiliar na elaboração e revisão do Projeto Terapêutico Singular dos pacientes, em conjunto com a equipe multiprofissional.
  • Desenvolver a Consciência Corporal trabalhando a imagem e o esquema corporal para que a criança reconheça seus limites físico-espaciais.
  • Atuar na regulação do tônus e postura em casos de hipotonia (comum no TEA) ou rigidez, promovendo melhor controle postural.
  • Desenvolver o planejamento motor (ideação e execução), essencial para atividades de vida diária (comer, vestir-se, escrever).
  • Promover a Facilitação da Comunicação Não-Verbal ensinado a usar o corpo e o gesto como formas de expressão, especialmente para pacientes com barreiras na linguagem oral.
  • Realizar orientações para o domicílio prescrevendo atividades simples que estimulem a autonomia e a organização motora dentro de casa.

Job Description

Job Number:

Supervisor de Reservas (HOT0CCRG)

Work Locations

Hilton Barra Rio de Janeiro
Avenida Abelardo Bueno Barra

A Reservations Supervisor oversees the Reservations Team and how it performs routine procedures in order to maximise revenue and Guest satisfaction.

What will I be doing?

As Reservations Supervisor, you oversee the Reservations Team and how it performs routine procedures in order to maximise revenue and Guest satisfaction. The Reservations Supervisor will work with the Reservations Team to develop future and repeat business opportunities. Specifically, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

  • Assist in the day-to-day operations of the Reservations Department
  • Manage telephone, email and other enquiries in a prompt and professional manner and in accordance with company standards ensuring accuracy and attention to detail at all times
  • Understand seasonal and historical trends and work within them to ensure maximum occupancy and average room rates
  • Identify new contacts, develop sales leads, and respond to sales opportunities in order to maximise revenue
  • Produce quotations and written confirmation to all clients
  • Monitor customer satisfaction regularly and resolve any outstanding issues to ensure future business
  • Ensure Team Members are developed effectively, maintain a thorough understanding of hotel facilities and processes, and generate a culture of high quality standards for relationship building, customer service, selling techniques, and billing and processing contracts
  • Ensure bookings are guaranteed and no show charges/late cancellation charges are applied where appropriate, and Reservations policies and procedures are followed to ensure Guest satisfaction
  • Monitor the appearance, standards and performance of the Reservations Team with an emphasis on training and teamwork
  • Assist in the recruiting, managing, training and developing of the Reservation team
  • Regularly monitor the team’s productivity, ensuring deliverables are met in accordance with the company’s established standards
  • Support the Revenue team in activities related to the creation, monitoring, and distribution of reports, as well as Hotel Distribution operations.

What are we looking for?

Experience as a Reservations Supervisor/Leader, or at least 2 years of experience in the Reservations Department.

  • Good organisational and administration skills
  • Positive attitude and good communication skills
  • Commitment to delivering a high level of customer service
  • Confident telephone manner
  • High level of IT skills

It would be advantageous in this position for you to demonstrate the following capabilities and distinctions:

  • Knowledge of the Opera hotel property management system (PMS) and the Omnibees and B2B Reservas distribution systems
  • Academic background in Hospitality/Tourism or another relevant related field
  • Completion of courses in Revenue Management and/or Hotel Distribution
  • Communication skills in Spanish and other languages

What will it be like to work for Hilton?

Hilton is the leading global hospitality company, spanning the lodging sector from luxurious full-service hotels and resorts to extended-stay suites and mid-priced hotels. For nearly a century, Hilton has offered business and leisure travelers the finest in accommodations, service, amenities and value. Hilton is dedicated to continuing its tradition of providing exceptional guest experiences across its global brands. Our vision “to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality” unites us as a team to create remarkable hospitality experiences around the world every day. And, our amazing Team Members are at the heart of it all!

title: OPERADOR(A) LOGISTICA I
description:
Com 124 anos de história, a Gerdau é a maior empresa brasileira produtora de aço e uma das principais fornecedoras de aços longos nas Américas e de aços especiais no mundo. No Brasil, também produz aços planos, além de minério de ferro para consumo próprio. Além disso, possui uma divisão de novos negócios, a Gerdau Next, com o objetivo de empreender em segmentos adjacentes ao aço. Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todas as suas operações.

Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais.

Como resultado de sua matriz produtiva sustentável, a Gerdau possui, atualmente, uma das menores médias de emissão de gases de efeito estufa (CO₂e), de 0,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço, o que representa aproximadamente a metade da média global do setor, de 1,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço (worldsteel). Para 2031, a meta da Gerdau é diminuir as emissões de carbono para 0,82 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço. As ações da Gerdau estão listadas nas bolsas de valores de São Paulo (B3) e Nova Iorque (NYSE).

Responsável em realizar armazenagem e carregamento de produtos acabados no PEPA e L3 com ponte rolante de cabine, obedecendo ao programa de produção e a padrões preestabelecidos, visando atender as necessidades dos clientes.

Pré-requisitos

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Diferencial
  • Experiência em armazéns
  • Experiência com ponte rolante
  • Experiência com empilhadeira
  • Experiência em movimentações internas

Temos como princípio a promoção de um ambiente diverso e inclusivo. Respeitamos e valorizamos a diversidade, por isso todas as pessoas qualificadas serão consideradas para as vagas sem distinção de deficiência, gênero, idade, identidade ou orientação sexual, nacionalidade, raça, religião, ou qualquer outra característica.

title: Cleaning and Waste Cluster Coordinator
description:
Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Cleaning and Waste Management Coordinator will support the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager in the planning, operational readiness, implementation, and monitoring of cleaning and waste management operations across FIFA Official Sites. The role supports waste minimization by reviewing and assessing procurement and service contracts and contributes to achieving defined waste diversion targets. The position is execution-focused and site-oriented, responsible for supporting readiness planning, coordinating day-to-day operations, and monitoring service delivery during test events and tournament operations. The CLW Coordinator plays a key role in translating strategic and functional requirements into practical, on-the-ground execution, ensuring operational continuity, compliance with FIFA requirements, and the timely identification and resolution of issues at the venue level.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support the development and readiness planning of cleaning and waste management operational plans across stadiums and other FIFA Official Sites.
  • Contribute to Service Level Agreement (SLA) development and alignment with Functional Area (FA) leads, ensuring requirements are clearly defined, operationally feasible, and venue-ready.
  • Support Service Level Requirement (SLR) alignment with stadium facility management teams, ensuring consistency with existing venue operations, infrastructure, and constraints.
  • Participate in readiness assessments, site walk-throughs, and test events to validate operational plans, staffing levels, infrastructure, and service flows.
  • Coordinate day-to-day cleaning and waste management operations in line with approved operational plans, service levels, and schedules.
  • Support match-day, non-match-day, and peak-load operations to ensure service continuity and operational effectiveness.
  • Monitor contractor performance on site and report deviations, risks, and non-compliance to the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager.
  • Support waste minimisation and waste diversion efforts through the correct implementation of waste streams and operational controls.
  • Assist in the deployment and operation of temporary waste management infrastructure, including interim collection points and resource recovery areas.
  • Monitor correct segregation and handling of waste streams and provide practical on-site guidance to teams and contractors.
  • Conduct regular site inspections to assess operational readiness, cleanliness standards, and waste management performance.
  • Support data collection, basic reporting, and performance tracking against defined waste diversion targets.
  • Identify operational issues early and support escalation and resolution processes in coordination with the Senior Manager.
  • Contribute to post-event reviews, lessons learned, and continuous operational improvements.
  • Support on-site supervision and coordination of cleaning and waste management crews.
  • Assist with operational briefings, inductions, and coordination meetings.
  • Promote compliance with HSE requirements and safe working practices across all operations.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in cleaning, waste management, facility operations, practical sustainability or event operations.
  • Experience of working at large-scale sporting events, major events, or complex multi-venue operations is strongly preferred.
  • Practical understanding of cleaning operations, sustainable upstream and downstream management of discarded materials, and contractor-based service delivery.
  • Experience coordinating service providers and working in live operational environments.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Facility Management, Environmental Management, Sustainability, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
  • Strong operational coordination and organisational skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in fast‑paced, high‑pressure event environments.
  • Clear communication skills and ability to work across multiple stakeholders.
  • Problem‑solving mindset with a hands‑on, solution‑oriented approach.
  • Good reporting and documentation skills.
  • Working knowledge of HSE principles related to cleaning and waste operations.
  • Willingness to travel extensively between FIFA Official Sites.
  • Flexibility to work irregular hours, including match days and peak operational periods.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer
